title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.12.28: Book of Order double-boss chain - at Ascension 10 (final act) each flank also chains a second boss, deranged so every ending leads into a different one (no self-pairing). Debug relic THEUNDERSTUDY-ALT_BOSS_DOUBLE_BOSS_DEBUG forces it on every act for testing.
